name: Parts for Kravel
summary: Having brought Kravel Koalbeard's parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig, you now carry Kravel's package back to him at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats. Dizzywig sends a message along with it: if Kravel wants more special orders, he will have to pay his tab.

sections.title: A Package and a Tab
sections.body: Wharfmaster Dizzywig gives you a package meant for Kravel Koalbeard, who waits at the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles. Dizzywig asks you to pass on a warning with it: if Kravel hopes for more special orders, he must first pay what he owes.

sections.title: Kravel's Welcome
sections.body: Kravel is glad the package has come, and says it still has to reach the gnomes. First, though, he sets the crate down, takes out one small item and slips it into his pocket.

faq.q: Who gives you the package for Kravel?
aliases: where do the parts come from
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet gives you the package and asks you to carry it back to Kravel Koalbeard.

faq.q: Where does Kravel Koalbeard await the delivery?
aliases: where to turn in parts for kravel
faq.answer: Kravel is at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles.

faq.q: What message does Dizzywig want delivered alongside the parts?
faq.answer: Dizzywig tells you to say that if Kravel wants more special orders, he will have to pay his tab.
This follows the step in which you carried Kravel's parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
